summary: BenefitElect, an employee benefits administration platform, discovered suspicious activity on its systems on April 2, 2025, following unauthorized access and exfiltration of files between March 30–31, 2025. An investigation determined that impacted data included benefits eligibility and onboarding census information such as names, addresses, dates of birth, and Social Security numbers. BenefitElect notified affected individuals on March 23, 2026, and offered 12–24 months of complimentary credit monitoring and identity theft protection services through IDX.
